newsitem.title: GERMANY: Debis sees double digit sales, profit climb-report.
newsitem.headline: Debis sees double digit sales, profit climb-report.

text.p: Daimler-Benz InterServices AG (Debis) should see double-digit growth in sales and profit in the current business year, chairman Klaus Mangold was quoted as telling a German newspaper on Wednesday.
The Boersen-Zeitung said Mangold expected sales to climb 14 percent to 13.3 billion marks and that profit would grow by an even faster rate.
Mangold also told the paper that leading profit centers were the information technologies unit Systemhaus, mobile telephone division Debitel and its financial services unit.

The Debis chief added that the company was still interested in increasing its 24.4 percent stake in French software company Cap Gemini. But he added that U.S. stock laws have hindered its attempts to take a larger stake.
Mangold said he expected to make a decision on a larger Cap Gemini stake in the first half of 1997 if such legal hurdles could be overcome.
